result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is 1Password if ease of use and team management matter most. Bitwarden is the better choice if keeping costs down is a priority.

## My top 5 picks

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My top recommendation)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults for departments and projects.
- Granular access permissions.
- Strong admin and employee management.
- Good integrations with business tools.

Business: approximately \$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users.

[1Password Business](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source foundations.
- Shared collections and vaults.
- Team administration and audit logs.
- Good security features for the price.
- Self-hosting options.

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month.

[Bitwarden Business](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for administration**

- Shared team folders.
- Detailed access management.
- Strong security and compliance features.
- Useful for businesses with stricter policies.

Business plans start around \$2/user/month for the entry-level tier.

[Keeper Business](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass — Best privacy-focused option**

- End-to-end encrypted password storage.
- Shared vaults.
- Secure notes and aliases.
- Attractive option for privacy-conscious businesses.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Dashlane — Best security monitoring**

- Password health monitoring.
- Security alerts.
- Business administration.
- Phishing protection features.

[Dashlane Business](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Pricing is indicative, in USD, and can vary by billing term and plan. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.openideurope.eu](https://www.openideurope.eu/reviews/password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Your priority | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall experience | 1Password |
| Lowest cost with good features | Bitwarden |
| Strong admin controls | 1Password |
| Privacy and encryption | Proton Pass |
| Security monitoring | Dashlane |


## A few questions to narrow it down

I'd like to recommend something that actually fits how your team works.

1\. **How many people?**

- 2–5
- 6–10
- 11–25
- 26–50

2\. **What will you primarily store?**

- Website and software logins
- Shared business accounts (social media, email, hosting, etc.)
- Server credentials, API keys and developer secrets
- A mixture of everything

3\. **What's your approximate budget per person per month?**

- Under £2
- £2–£5
- £5–£10
- Happy to pay more for better security

With those answers, I can narrow it down to the best option for your team, rather than simply recommending the most popular product.
